scripts.build_all: npm run tauri android build -- --apk && npm run tauri build -- --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && npm run tauri build && npm run  move_bundle
scripts.move_bundle: rm -rf bundles/* && mkdir -p bundles/android bundles/windows bundles/linux && cp src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release.apk bundles/android && cp src-tauri/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/bundle/nsis/tauri-app_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe bundles/windows && cp -r src-tauri/target/release/bundle/* bundles/linux/
